system.name: CAV-MAE (Contrastive Audio-Visual Masked Auto-Encoder)
system.one_liner: A self-supervised audio-visual model that combines a contrastive loss and masked reconstruction on one shared joint encoder.

content.variant_note: tokenization panel, two component designs in a grey panel, and the combined model with both loss paths
content.argues: Contrastive audio-visual learning and masked audio-visual reconstruction can be combined in one model, CAV-MAE, that keeps the strengths of both.
content.subject: Audio and image tokenization, two baseline designs, and the proposed model that combines their two losses.

panels.label: B) Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning

panels.label: B) Vanilla Audio-Visual Masked Auto-Encoder

panels.label: C) Contrastive Audio-Visual Masked Auto-Encoder

lessons.what_to_learn: To show a method that fuses two known objectives, draw both components in one grey panel in the same visual grammar as the final model and join them to it with a big labelled arrow. Use one colour per modality across tokens, encoders, embeddings and arrows so each stream can be followed through shared blocks.
lessons.suits: Papers that combine two learning objectives or architectures (contrastive plus reconstruction, two modalities, shared plus separate encoders) and must show what is shared and what is added.

evidence: we design the Contrastive Audio-Visual Masked Autoencoder (CAV-MAE) (shown in Figure 1.C)
CAV-MAE integrates two major self-supervised frameworks: contrastive audio-visual learning and cross-modal masked data modeling

summary: CAV-MAE combines contrastive learning and masked data modelling to learn a joint and coordinated audio-visual representation. Figure 1 has three lettered parts and one grey component panel. A) tokenizes a 128 by 1024 spectrogram and a 224 by 224 image into 16 by 16 patches (A1 to A512, V1 to V196). B) stacks the two prior designs in a grey panel: a conventional contrastive audio-visual model with separate encoders and a dashed Contrastive Loss arrow, and a vanilla audio-visual masked auto-encoder with masking, a joint encoder, a joint decoder and a Reconstruction Loss arc. A big Combination arrow leads to C), the full model, with both losses. Green marks audio and orange visual.
summary_zh: CAV-MAE 结合对比学习与掩码重建。图 1 分三部分：A 把频谱图和图像切成 16×16 补丁；B 在灰色面板里画出传统对比模型和朴素音视频 MAE；粗箭头 Combination 指向含两种损失的完整模型 C。绿色为音频，橙色为视觉。
notes: Prior labels kept (model-anatomy, side-by-side-contrast, objective-graph). The wiring inside the joint encoder in C) is read from the drawing only: three stacks labelled Audio, Concatenate and Visual feed it, and small LN boxes marked a and v sit inside it (LN is not expanded in the figure). The digest lists 26 placed bitmaps but only 3 distinct images; the visible picture content is the spectrogram and the cat photo with their patches.
